description: Create a manual journal entry (daybook transaction) in Billy with balanced debit/credit lines. Validates balance client-side before asking for approval. Supports safe-retry deduplication via idempotencyKey. Created as draft by default; state=approved books it immediately.

daybookId.description: Daybook ID (see list_daybooks; defaults to the org default)

description.description: Header description (max ~100 chars — Billy rejects longer)

idempotencyKey.description: Safe-retry dedupe key (stored in apiType): if a transaction with this key already exists it is returned instead of creating a duplicate. Use for retries after timeouts.

lines.description: Journal lines — debits must equal credits per currency or Billy rejects with 422

accountId.description: Account ID the line applies to (see list_accounts)

contraAccountId.description: Contra account ID the line is applied against

currencyId.description: Currency code, e.g. 'DKK' (defaults to org base currency)

side.description: Which side of the entry this line is on

taxRateId.description: Tax rate ID for the line

verbose.description: Return the full Billy response. Default false: compact records with key fields only (saves ~90% context)

voucherNo.description: Voucher number, e.g. a bill reference

name: create_daybook_transaction
